svg.title: Day 2: a whiteboard on a stand holds three framework cards — the triple bottom line circles, the equation I = P × A × T and a population pyramid for the DTM — with a sticky note asking “Corvania mine?”. Two students in front argue the case, and 3D speech bubbles float above them: because…, as a result…, should…, while…. A floating card reads Seminar, Week 2–6.
